semantic_review.l1: All queryable tables use reviewed entity-to-column annotations, not name-substring inference.
semantic_review.l2: Field coverage and SQL types fully checked. Existing descriptions retained; high-risk identity/workspace/resource distinctions spot-checked, not every description externally revalidated.

limits: Catalog is a union across incidents; a particular incident may lack tables or fields.
Compared distributed SQL and CSV headers, not a running database or all row values.
Entity tags indicate schema coverage; values and nested payloads require execution evidence.
